title.narrative: Strengthening the Supportive Environment and Scaling up Prevention, Treatment and Care to Contain the HIV Epidemic in the Republic of Tajikistan - Tajikistan (01-Jan-2018-31-Dec-2020)

description.narrative: Tajikistan, HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Tajikistan)This program has the following goals: Reduce new HIV infections among key populations.. Improve HIV care continuum for key populations and PLWH.. Improve Critical enablers for KP and PLWH.. Enhance national surveillance system for HIV services.. The objectives of this program are: Ensure expanded coverage of high-risk key populations (PWID, SW, Prisoners) and vulnerable groups (labor migrants, the youth, pregnant women, children) with high quality HIV prevention services. Ensure timely detection of human immunodeficiency virus among key populations and vulnerable groups and refer them to the care system.. HIV treatment, care and support. Strengthen the healthcare system. Strengthen supporting environment to improve access of high-risk key populations to services
